basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old card enthusiast based in Vienna, Austria. My passion for collecting and crafting custom card decks started about a decade ago when I stumbled upon a local card game meetup. During the day, I work as a graphic designer, which complements my hobby perfectly. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new card game strategies, engaging in online gaming, and keeping up with the latest in motorsports. I'm currently single and usually online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design and card game strategies. I honed my design skills through a mix of formal education and self-teaching, often applying them to create custom card designs. My knowledge of card games has grown from years of playing and interacting with the card gaming community both online and offline.
